title: Making a Deal with your Hidden Observer (ORIGINAL)
description: Taken from the file, "Bite the Pillow", this deepener will help you to trust me as I put safeguards in your mind, to protect you from any suggestions or triggers that would go against your morals or ethics. This deepener helps safeguard against other hypnotists as well, because I want you to be safe. And once I feel you are nice and safe... I help you understand how much fun it is to relax some control, so long as you trust me. Leaving you like a child in the corner while the adults talk, I make a deal with the Hidden Observer in your mind, that every bit they let me in, I will give you pleasure.
author: Mistress Shibby
